1.consolidated_definition: Grupera. Apero que sujeta la silla a la base de la cola del caballo. Baticola. Algunos dicen gorupa, gurupa, gorupera y gurupera.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Gorupera. Apero that secures the saddle to the base of a horse's tail. Baticola. Some people also refer to it as gorupa, gurupa, or gurupera.
